dated-demo-plays.text: As a presenter, I want each dated play to show a keripy kli identity and a ckeri transaction on Cardano preprod, so that the audience can inspect the identity event and ledger result together. A cast appears only after the connected preprod run has produced transaction IDs and fresh readbacks.

For Cardano KERI identity actions, the planned source is its local follower indexer: ckeri writes use --store PATH or CKERI_STORE, and reads use explicit --backend local --store PATH (or an indexer-backed endpoint where supported). Record the indexed chain point and freshness. Singular's ordinary path now reads raw outputs and history through Koios; its logical sessions are Unbound and its facts Unverified, and #107 tracks a persistent registry follower. A Koios asset lookup alone does not close these demo stories. The Cardano KERI indexer contract tracks the identity side. The older V1 cast used Koios and remains historical evidence.

choose-a-dated-play.text: The Cardano KERI consumer mapping is separate from Singular naming. Naming is not a prerequisite for Cardano KERI's identity path.

planned-major-release-tags.text: Demo 1 ships in the 0.x series; the latest release is listed at https://github.com/lambdasistemi/singular/releases/latest, and v0.12.0 is the one the runbook was written against. The major tags below were drafted before that decision. They are targets for the later plays, not published artifacts.
Candidate demos cite their actual build and manifest until the relevant milestone release is cut.
